trigger_definition: Opponent Jin executes uf+4 and the player Jin blocks it.
eligible_actor: Confirmed defender participant, stable across screen-side changes

timing_window.start: defender first actionable time after block
timing_window.end: opponent first actionable recovery; include uncertainty
timing_window.ambiguity_policy: UNKNOWN whenever uncertainty crosses classification boundary

valid_responses: reviewed standing punish; candidate Jin 2,4 requires in-game verification
invalid_responses: fully observed no qualifying response with established eligibility
exclusion_conditions: wall contact or unknown wall state
successful_outcomes: verified attributable game punish plus qualifying contact
failed_outcomes: eligible full window, expert-adjudicated absence of any qualifying punish
